minutes.headline: Finance Committee planned joint growth presentations and a shared definition of level services; accountant explained cherry sheet net shortfall.
minutes.summary: The committee discussed arranging a joint presentation with the School Committee, Selectmen and Planning Board on demographics and growth, and the need to define level services before budget season. A member reported on a School Committee meeting covering bus drop-off policy, enrollment, water testing and the extended day program. The town accountant explained the final cherry sheet against estimates and new growth timing. Prior minutes were approved and the meeting adjourned.

what_happened.line: The accountant said the final cherry sheet left a small net shortfall, because assessments rose over the estimate, mostly school choice sending tuition.
The accountant said the shortfall could be balanced through local receipts adjustments without going back to Town Meeting.
The Chair will keep pursuing joint presentations on growth and demographics and follow up with the School Committee and the Planning Board.
A note on the middle-high school project has been rolled over and would be renewed until January 2020, then the final bond issued.
Next meeting is August 22nd to begin goals and level services discussion; the one after is September 12th.

why_it_matters: The cherry sheet gap is being closed through local receipts rather than a new Town Meeting vote, so residents will not be asked to vote on it, but it uses local revenue that would otherwise be available elsewhere.
The shared definition of level services, still unsettled, will shape the budget proposals and any override questions residents see in the coming budget season.
watch_next: August 22nd meeting: goals and level services discussion, followed by a meeting on September 12th.
